definitions.explanation: Leaves growing on or fallen from a tree. Often evokes a literary or seasonal image.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}になると{木の葉|このは}が{赤|あか}く{色|いろ}づく。
examples.english: When autumn comes, the leaves turn red.

examples.japanese: {風|かぜ}に{吹|ふ}かれて{木の葉|このは}がくるくると{舞|ま}い{落|お}ちた。
examples.english: Blown by the wind, the leaves spiraled down.

notes:
READING:
Read as このは. The kanji {木|こ}の{葉|は} is usually written as a single compound {木の葉|このは}.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {葉|は}: leaf (general)
- {葉っぱ|はっぱ}: leaf (slightly casual/childlike)
- {木の葉|このは}: specifically tree leaves, often literary

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {木の葉|このは}が{散|ち}る: leaves fall/scatter
- {木の葉|このは}が{揺|ゆ}れる: leaves sway
- {枯|か}れ{木の葉|このは}: dead/withered leaves
